updates.title: Redeploying Claude Fable 5
updates.summary: Anthropic is redeploying Claude Fable 5 starting July 1 following the lifting of export controls, with updated cybersecurity safeguards and a new industry jailbreak framework.

updates.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
updates.summary: Our most agentic Sonnet yet, with top-tier intelligence for coding and everyday professional work.

updates.title: Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists
updates.summary: Claude Science is a customizable app that integrates the tools and packages researchers most often use, produces auditable artifacts, and provides flexible access to computing resources.

updates.title: More details on Fable 5’s cyber safeguards and our jailbreak framework
updates.summary: What is and isn't blocked by our cyber classifiers, and a first draft of our jailbreak severity framework

updates.title: Introducing Claude Tag
updates.summary: Claude Tag is a new way for teams to work with Claude.

updates.title: Statement on the US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
updates.summary: The US government has issued an export control directive to suspend all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by any foreign national, whether inside or outside the United States.

updates.title: Introducing Claude Corps
updates.summary: We’re launching Claude Corps, a national fellowship program for people early in their careers who are passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.

updates.title: Expanding Project Glasswing
updates.summary: We’re extending Project Glasswing to approximately 150 new organizations in more than fifteen countries

updates.title: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah's remarks on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical "Magnifica humanitas"
updates.summary: The full text of Chris Olah's remarks on the Pope's encyclical on AI.

updates.title: Widening the conversation on frontier AI
updates.summary: Over the past several months, we’ve been organizing dialogues with groups whose work and traditions bear on the questions raised by AI.
